extract_metadata: false omits the YAML frontmatter block from markdown output

```elixir title="Elixir"
engine_config = "{\"content\":{\"extract_metadata\":false}}"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config)
url = "https://example.com"
result = Crawlberg.scrape_async(engine, url)
IO.inspect(result.status_code)
IO.inspect(result.metadata.title)
IO.inspect(result.markdown.content)
```
